character.name: Player Modern Clothes
character.prompt: Korean Joseon folk pixel art rendering style, dark warm brown single color outline (no pure black), gentle mid value contrast, soft dawn light from the left. A young modern-day Korean man who has just arrived from the present day, deliberately out of place in this historical world: he wears a cold neutral gray hooded zip-up jacket over a plain white t-shirt, slim dark charcoal jeans and white sneakers, with a slate gray canvas backpack on his back. Short modern black hair, no hat. His entire outfit stays cold desaturated gray and white - it must NOT pick up any mossy green, earth brown or dawn warmth from the world around him; the gray clothing is intentionally alien to the palette. Standing in a relaxed neutral pose.
